Dynamic packaging is generally considered to be a method of selling holidays, whereby a consumer is able to build their own package holiday from a combination of travel components (e.g. flights, accommodation, and car rental) instead of purchasing a pre-defined package.
Flight-plus is a form of “dynamic packaging” where a business sells 1) a flight and 2) either accommodation or car hire, where 2) is within 24 hours of 1).
